title: fix(runtime): a sandboxed body's thrown plain object is answered with its own message, never 'undefined: …' or '[object Object]' (#23718)
body:
Fixes #23718
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A sandboxed body (a `type: 'script'` action body, or a sandboxed hook body) that throws a value which is not an `Error`, the plain `{ code, message }` object metadata app bodies throw, is now answered with that value's own `message` as the client sentence. Its code is kept, as before. One place changed: the wrapper's `REJECT_HANDLER` in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`, the one writer that flattens a rejection into `__error`. No door changed. `@objectstack/types` is not changed, and PR #23717's identity relay is left as it landed.

- The handler flattened every rejection as `NAME: MESSAGE`, else `String(e)`. A plain object has no class name and no `toString` of its own, so the doors served `undefined: MESSAGE`, or `[object Object]` when it had no `message`.
- A non-`Error` object is now flattened under the default name `Error`, the one prefix `userFacingMessage` strips, so its `message` reaches `innerMessage` byte for byte. A `name` on a plain object is a field, not a frame, and gets no prefix.
- With no usable `message` (a non-blank string) and no `toString` of its own, the sentence is `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE` (`Internal server error`), read from `@objectstack/types`, never a literal. It is what the doors already answer for a fault with no business message, measured below. A value with a `toString` of its own keeps it.
- Unchanged: a thrown `Error` (or subclass), a thrown primitive, and a value whose reads throw. The new branch is inside a `try`; any throw there falls back to the old expression, so a throwing getter behaves exactly as it does today.
- `code`, `status`, `fields` and `userMessage` still ride `__errorInfo`, untouched.
- One line outside the handler: `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE` joins the file's existing `@objectstack/types` import, so the handler can interpolate it.

## Before / after, measured

Rig: PR #23717's. better-sqlite3 `:memory:` under the real `ObjectQL`, action bodies through `actionBodyRunnerFactory`, hook bodies through `hookBodyRunnerFactory`, both over a real `QuickJSScriptRunner`, and `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` over a real Fetch `Request`. The `/data` classification is read at function level (`mapDataError`), as PR #23717 read it. "Before" was read at base `9e0945cf45` (and again under the ablation below), "after" at `7bd01e068d`.

| thrown value | door | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{ code: 'EMAIL_TAKEN', message: 'That address is already on file' }` | action | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, `undefined: That address is already on file` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, `That address is already on file` |
| `{ code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD' }` | action | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `[object Object]` | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `Internal server error` |
| `{ code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD', status: 409, message }` | action | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `undefined: …` | `409 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, the message |
| `{}` | action | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `[object Object]` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `Internal server error` |
| `[]` | action | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` after the wall-clock ceiling (no rejection was recorded) | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `Internal server error`, at once |
| `{ name: 'TypeError', message: 'forged' }` | action | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` (read as a crash) | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `forged` |
| hook body, `{ code: 'EMAIL_TAKEN', message }`, behind a host handler's write | action | `400`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, `undefined: …` | `400`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, the message |
| hook body, `{ code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD' }`, behind a host handler's write | action | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `[object Object]` | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `Internal server error` |
| hook body, `{ code: 'EMAIL_TAKEN', message }`, behind a script body's write (two VM hops) | action | `400`, `undefined: …` | `400`, the message |
| hook body, `{ code: 'EMAIL_TAKEN', message }` | `/data` classification | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, `undefined: …` | the same, with the message |
| hook body, `{ code: 'DUPLICATE_RECORD' }` | `/data` classification | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `[object Object]` | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `Internal server error` |
| CONTROL `new Error('x')` | action, hook at action, `/data` | `400`, `x` | unchanged |
| CONTROL `Error` carrying `EMAIL_TAKEN` | action | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode: EMAIL_TAKEN`, its message | unchanged |
| CONTROL `Error` with no message, carrying `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | action | `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, `Error` | unchanged |
| CONTROL `'Name is required'` / `null` | action | `400`, `Name is required` / `null` | unchanged |
| CONTROL `{ toString() { return 'custom words'; } }` | action | `400`, `custom words` | unchanged |
| CONTROL capability denial (a sandbox fault) | action | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, `Internal server error` | unchanged |
| CONTROL `{ code, get message() { throw … } }` | action | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` after the wall-clock ceiling | unchanged (falls back as today) |

The no-message sentence: the action door answers a sandbox fault (a capability denial) and a crash with `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, `Internal server error`, and the `/data` classification's unclassified-fault terminal answers the same sentence. That is the one sentence the doors already give for a fault with no business message.

## Readings the dispatch asked for

- **(a) The hook door crosses the same writer: holds.** A sandboxed hook body's plain-object throw broke the same way, behind a host handler's write, behind a script body's write (two VM hops, via the nested-refusal relay), and in the `/data` classification. All three are measured and pinned.
- **(b) No wrapper or `SandboxError:` prefix reaches the client: holds.** The pump loop builds `innerMessage` as `userFacingMessage(withoutSandboxErrorPrefix(__error))`. The new flattening is `Error: MESSAGE`, which those two strips turn back into exactly `MESSAGE`. The pins assert the client sentence by equality, so a wrapper or prefix would turn them red.
- **The `400` question: not this writer.** The status comes from `resolveThrownHttpError` (`@objectstack/types`): `.status`, then `.statusCode`, then the door's fallback, never a status derived from the code. A thrown `Error` carrying `DUPLICATE_RECORD` and no `status` also answers `400 DUPLICATE_RECORD`, and a plain object that declares `status: 409` answers `409`. So it is not specific to plain objects, and nothing in the reject handler decides it. The resolver's precedence table and ADR-0112's 2026-08-27 amendment ("`SandboxError` answers **400**") both declare this behaviour. Not folded in.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/plain-object-throw-sentence.test.ts` (new, 10, beside the change). Plain object with a message (action and hook origin); no message; `[]`; a message beginning `Error: `; a named plain object. CONTROLS: `Error` (the log reads `action 'submit' threw: Error: x`, exactly as before), `TypeError`, a string, a custom `toString`.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox-plain-object-throw-client-sentence.test.ts` (new, 10): the door rows above. Action door (2 + CONTROL), hook at the action door (behind a handler: 2; two VM hops: 1; CONTROL), `/data` classification (2 + CONTROL).
- Ablation, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode) with an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore on the absolute path. The anchor `globalThis.__error = flat !== undefined ? flat : (…)` was replaced by the old expression and a marker: anchor 1 to 0, blob `bfc8615afe02` to `d757d0101457`. Result `Tests 13 failed | 7 passed (20)`. Exactly the 13 plain-object rows went red (6 unit, 7 door: `expected 'undefined: That address is already on…'`, `expected '[object Object]'`, `expected 'TypeError: forged'`, and the `[]` row timing out). All 7 CONTROLS stayed green. Restore: blob == HEAD `bfc8615afe02`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The pins import the runner from `src` by relative path, so no build sits in the resolution path.

At `a4145db7b2`:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` (the package's `test` script): `Test Files 395 passed (395)`, `Tests 5918 passed | 19 skipped (5937)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK`: 27 files / 190 errors / 68 pinned signatures held. Both new test files are in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program (`--listFilesOnly`: 2).
- The two new files by path: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`.

## Gates

At `a4145db7b2`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 commands from 4 changed paths (merge base `9e0945cf4`). All 61 ran, with exit codes captured before any pipe. 60 answered exit 0 on the first pass. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3, no workspace `dist`). After `pnpm build` (75 tasks), it answered exit 0 (110 entry points across 68 packages). `--ran`: `61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.

Lint: a narrowed run, in the scoped form `eslint.config.mjs`'s own header prescribes.
- `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-inline-config packages/runtime` (the `pnpm lint` binary and flags): exit 0.
- `--format json` over the four changed files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The changeset is ignored by the config, as under `pnpm lint`.
- Positive control: the same command reds on a restricted root `@objectstack/spec` import (`Data`) piped on stdin at a `packages/runtime` path: exit 1, `no-restricted-imports`.

CI's families are this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- In-process: a caller that catches the `SandboxError` for such a throw reads the value's `message` as `innerMessage`. Its log-only `message` now reads `KIND 'NAME' threw: Error: MESSAGE`. The changeset states it.
- A plain object's `message` that begins with a native error name (`TypeError: …`) is now read as a crash (`500`), the same way `new Error('TypeError: …')` already is. Before, the `undefined: ` prefix hid it.
- Not addressed here, and reported to the dispatching seat: a rejection whose flattening throws, or flattens to an empty string, is never recorded. `throw ''`, `throw Object.create(null)` and a throwing `message` getter all leave the pump to spin to the wall-clock ceiling, then answer `500` with a "while awaiting host calls" log line. Measured before and after; this PR keeps that path exactly as today, as the dispatch ruled.
- `origin/main` moved by one commit after this branch was cut (`a515abdd8c`, PR #23719, a `packages/rest` refactor with no file in common with this diff). It is not merged here; the PR's CI runs on the merge ref.
